rendering.recommended_scale: Preserve aspect ratio, ideally use integer display scaling; keep each animation frame untrimmed.

manifest.instructions: Crop by frames[id].x/y/w/h without auto sprite detection; 8x5 fixed grid. Use consistent entity pivot_px and the untrimmed 192x256 frame for all animations. Ignore the checkerboard preview as a sprite source.

enemies.description: Moss-covered, mushroom-dotted forest boar with bark-like armor and tusks; patrols platforms, pursues the player, and makes a brief damaging charge.
Squat forest troll wearing a giant red-speckled mushroom cap; slow land enemy that winds up and pounds the ground at close range.
Small owl-like forest spirit with oversized leaf-shaped wings; flaps above platforms, follows a flight route, and dives toward the player.
Rooted carnivorous plant with a large pink flower-mouth and leafy crown; periodically fires glowing seed projectiles horizontally toward the player.

projectiles.description: Luminous green-gold magical seed orb fired by Snapvine Pod. Loop frames 0–3 in flight; upon collision play one-shot impact frames 4–7 and despawn.

notes: The suggested collision boxes, pivots, speed and timing are implementation starting points, not engine-tested hitboxes.
The Snapvine release pose includes a painted glowseed for visual feedback. Spawn exactly one separate glowseed entity on fire animation index 1; do not double-spawn from the artwork.
Damage_active_indices are zero-based positions within their animation.frames arrays, not atlas column indices.
Do not let defeated enemies deal contact damage after the death state begins.
The source visuals were generated as a cohesive sprite sheet and standardized to a fixed grid; frame-to-frame motion may need alignment or pixel editing for perfectly seamless animation.
trim lists are alpha-content bounds [left, top, right_exclusive, bottom_exclusive] relative to the untrimmed frame, for optional optimization only; do not crop without compensating pivot offsets.
